main.en: Deploy an image model, send a prompt with size and quality, decode the base64 result and save it.
main.ro: Image model deploy karein, size aur quality ke saath prompt bhejein, base64 nateeja decode kar ke save karein.

explain.en: Azure uses the gpt-image series; DALL-E 3 was retired in March 2026. The models create pictures from text and can edit existing ones. Some need an access request, so check availability before you plan.
explain.ro: Azure gpt-image series istemal karta hai; DALL-E 3 March 2026 mein retire ho gaya. Ye models text se tasveer banate aur maujooda tasveer edit karte hain. Kuch ke liye access ki darkhwast chahiye, is liye pehle availability dekhein.

explain.en: Main parameters: prompt, size (for example 1024x1024), quality (low for drafts, high for final pictures), n for the number, background for transparency where supported, and output_format. The result holds b64_json, so decode before saving.
explain.ro: Bare parameters: prompt, size (jaise 1024x1024), quality (draft ke liye low, aakhri tasveer ke liye high), n tadad, background transparency (jahan support ho), aur output_format. Nateeje mein b64_json hota hai, is liye save se pehle decode karein.

explain.en: Prompts and pictures pass content filters. A blocked request returns an error and no picture. Pictures carry content credentials that say they were made with AI.
explain.ro: Prompts aur tasveerein content filters se guzarti hain. Roki gayi request error deti hai, tasveer nahi. Tasveeron mein content credentials hote hain jo AI se banne ka batate hain.

deep.en: Think like a photographer when you write the prompt: subject, action, place, style, light, camera angle, colors, mood. "A red bicycle leaning on a blue wall, morning light, wide angle, flat illustration" gives more control than "nice bicycle". Change one part at a time and keep the best version of the prompt.
deep.ro: Prompt photographer ki tarah likhein: mauzu, kaam, jagah, andaz, roshni, camera ka zaviya, rang, mood. "A red bicycle leaning on a blue wall, morning light, wide angle, flat illustration" "nice bicycle" se zyada control deta hai. Ek waqt mein ek hissa badlein aur prompt ki behtareen shakal rakhein.

deep.en: Responsible use belongs to the task: no deceptive pictures of real people, no protected characters or logos of others, a label for viewers, and a person who approves pictures before they are published.
deep.ro: Zimmedar istemal kaam ka hissa hai: asal logon ki dhokay wali tasveer nahi, doosron ke mehfooz kirdar ya logo nahi, dekhne walon ke liye nishan, aur shaya karne se pehle insan ki manzoori.

text.en: "New visual outputs" also means video. Sora 2 in Foundry creates a clip from text, from an image or from an existing video (remix), and it can add sound. You can try it in the video playground or call it through REST.
text.ro: "Naye visual outputs" mein video bhi hai. Foundry mein Sora 2 text, image ya maujooda video (remix) se clip banata hai aur awaaz bhi de sakta hai. Video playground mein azmayein ya REST se call karein.

text.en: Rendering takes minutes, so the API is asynchronous. The POST answer holds an id and a status, not the video.
text.ro: Rendering mein minute lagte hain, is liye API asynchronous hai. POST ke jawab mein id aur status hota hai, video nahi.

text.en: A targeted edit of an existing video, for example the color of a car.
text.ro: Maujooda video mein khaas tabdeeli, jaise gaari ka rang.

text.en: More quality and precise edits; lower cost and faster.
text.ro: Zyada quality aur bareek editing; kam kharcha aur tez.

text.en: Tool of the Responses API that creates an image inside a conversation.
text.ro: Responses API ka tool jo guftagu ke andar image banata hai.

topics.code:
curl -X POST "https://my-res.openai.azure.com/openai/v1/videos" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "api-key: $KEY" \
  -d '{"model": "sora-2", "prompt": "A paper boat at sunrise.", "size": "1280x720", "seconds": "8"}'

curl "https://my-res.openai.azure.com/openai/v1/videos/$ID" -H "api-key: $KEY"

curl -L "https://my-res.openai.azure.com/openai/v1/videos/$ID/content?variant=video" \
  -H "api-key: $KEY" --output boat.mp4

how.en: Draft with quality low and n 2 or 3, then create the final picture with high.
how.ro: quality low aur n 2 ya 3 se draft, phir high se aakhri tasveer.

how.en: To keep a product unchanged, edit its photo with a mask instead of generating a new one.
how.ro: Product waisa hi rakhna ho to nayi banane ke bajaye us ki photo mask ke saath edit karein.

how.en: Write what should be visible; long stories in the prompt help less.
how.ro: Jo nazar aana chahiye woh likhein; prompt mein lambi kahani kam kaam aati hai.

text.en: Create one draft and save it:
text.ro: Ek draft bana kar save karna:

example.code:
result = openai.images.generate(
    model="images-prod", size="1024x1024", quality="low",
    prompt="A red bicycle on a white background, studio light")
png = base64.b64decode(result.data[0].b64_json)
open("bike.png", "wb").write(png)

right.ro: Vision samajhta hai; image models banate hain.

text.en: Generate starts from words; edit starts from a picture and can use a mask.
text.ro: Generate alfaaz se shuru hota hai; edit tasveer se, aur mask istemal kar sakta hai.

text.en: quality sets the effort and cost; size sets the dimensions.
text.ro: quality mehnat aur kharcha tay karti hai; size lambai chaurai.

exam.en: Match the need with a parameter: cheap draft → quality low, three ideas → n=3, logo without background → background transparent.
exam.ro: Zaroorat ko parameter se milana: sasta draft → quality low, teen ideas → n=3, baghair background logo → background transparent.

exam.en: Change only one area → images.edit with a mask.
exam.ro: Sirf ek hissa badalna → mask ke saath images.edit.
